title: One place lost in the key inside a clue word: repeating and sliding keys with one key letter skipped or used twice inside EASTNORTHEAST or BERLINCLOCK
k4_result: 0 settings with 7+ checks out of 799,884,445,472 (6,669,928 key streams x 119,924 settings: test A 408, test B 10,076, test C 109,440 per stream; chance expects 0.114, 0.00005 and 0.0005 passes). controls: Main run, 3 shuffled K4s on a third of the alphabets each: 0 settings with 7+ checks; near misses 67, 22, 18 (K4 on the same thirds: 64, 60, 75); best decrypted scores -7.35, -7.28, -7.09. scope_limits: Exactly one slip of one place (one key letter skipped or used twice) inside a clue block; a slip of two or more places inside a block, or two slips inside the same block, is not covered. Key rules: repeating key and sliding key (differences repeat; slip either in the key word or in the running key) only; no progressive, autokey, stacked or chain keys with a slip. Test A (one block alone): only key lengths that leave 7+ checks, i.e. repeating L 2-6 on clue 1 and 2-4 on clue 2, sliding L 2-5 and 2-3. Tests B and C (both blocks, any key offset between them): L 2-12; test C went to 12 where the plan asked for 8. Keys longer than 12 with a slip are undecidable from 24 letters. Tableaux: A-Z, KRYPTOS and 666,991 dictionary keyword alphabets (plain, column-mixed, keyed-column-mixed) in five layouts, Vigenere and Beaufort; no hidden alphabets. A slip in the plaintext (a dropped clue letter) is not tested: it contradicts the published clue positions. No transposition layer. Controls in the main run used a third of the alphabets each.

negative.family: interrupted key: one place lost inside a clue word
negative.hypothesis: K4 is a periodic-key cipher on a keyword tableau in which Sanborn lost his place in the key once inside EASTNORTHEAST or BERLINCLOCK (one key letter skipped or used twice), so every periodic test on that block fails.
negative.scope: Slip before any letter of a clue block, +1 or -1 key place. Repeating key, sliding key with the slip in the key word, sliding key with the slip in the running key. A: one block alone with a slip, 7+ checks (L 2-6 / 2-4). B: one slip in either block + any key offset between the blocks, L 2-12. C: one slip in each block + any offset, L 2-12. A-Z, KRYPTOS and 666,991 dictionary keyword alphabets incl. transposition-mixed x 5 layouts x Vigenere/Beaufort = 6,669,928 key streams, 799,884,445,472 exact settings
negative.outcome: Dead: 0 settings with 7+ checks on K4 (chance expects 0.11; 3 shuffled K4s on a third of the alphabets and 6 on all of them: 0 each); near misses with 5-6 checks: K4 199 against 48-211 on six full-size shuffled K4s (chance expects 82), best decryption -7.34 per quadgram (shuffled -7.09 to -7.35; English above -5.1); planted slips found with the slip point named 4/4, three read back 97/97
